config.notes: QUT course pages (www.qut.edu.au/courses/<slug>) carry both the Australian/NZ view and the international view in the page text, domestic first then international. Requirements block: "CRICOS code <code> Delivery <dom> Delivery <intl> Duration <dom> Duration <intl> Entry <dom months> Entry <intl months>" - intakes = last "Entry" months (international). Fees: "2027: CSP $X" (UG domestic) or "2027: $X per year full-time (96 credit points)" (PG domestic fee-paying) then "2027: $Y per year full-time (96 credit points)" (international) - fee = last 2027 per-year line; lines at 48 credit points (graduate certificates, a half-year whole-course amount) are not read. Checked against the 2027 International Quick Guide (cms.qut.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0008/1566476/international-quick-gide-2027.pdf). IELTS table: "IELTS Academic / One Skill Retake Overall 6.5 Listening 6 ...". Duration and campus anchored on "CRICOS code <code>" so study-area listing pages (/study/..., /your-future-in-law) give no extras. online.qut.edu.au pages (QUT Online, domestic online) carry none of these. Teaching periods: https://www.qut.edu.au/about/key-dates-and-academic-calendar/teaching-periods (Semester 1 = February, Semester 2 = July, Summer = November).
